x-crawmatic.task: C10 (F21) — backups from inside Railway, measured, encrypted, off-host
x-crawmatic.why_cron_never_restarts: restartPolicyType NEVER: a cron run that failed must NOT be retried in a tight loop against production; the next scheduled run is the retry, and the failure is loud (DR-ALERT + non-zero exit).
x-crawmatic.volume_note: A Railway volume attaches to exactly ONE service. If the encrypted sets must also be served to the ops host (scripts/dr/backup_prod.sh --mode pull), do NOT create a second service with a second volume: drop cronSchedule on THIS service, set startCommand to '/app/serve.py' and DR_SCHEDULE_LOOP=1, and the same process both serves /backups and runs the 4-hourly backup itself. Both shapes are written out in scripts/dr/RUNBOOK.md §Owner gate (C11 step 3).
x-crawmatic.pghost_must_be: *.railway.internal — backup.sh refuses to dump over anything else, which is the entire point of the service (0.853 GB/day of public egress removed).
